items.notes: Sets a hotend target temperature and continues without waiting.
S waits only while heating; R waits for heating or cooling. A host-command interruption can also affect the wait.
Sets a heated-bed target temperature and continues without waiting.
S waits only while heating; R waits for heating or cooling. A host-command interruption can also affect the wait.
Controls a selected fan. S commonly ranges from 0 to 255, while fan selection and extra parameters depend on configuration.
Pauses a print that Marlin is running from an SD card. Pause behavior can depend on firmware configuration and enabled features.
Makes E values absolute, independently of the positioning mode used for the motion axes.
Makes each E value a relative extruder movement, independently of the positioning mode used for the motion axes.
Disables one or more stepper motors or sets an inactivity timeout. Position can be lost if an axis moves after its motor is disabled.
Turns off the selected fan. Fan selection and availability depend on the printer configuration.
Sets the extrusion flow percentage for the selected extruder. Make small, intentional adjustments and confirm the active extruder.
Supports object identification and cancellation when the required Marlin feature is enabled and the file supplies object information.
Starts Marlin's filament-change procedure when Advanced Pause is enabled and configured for the printer.
